description: This vulnerability pattern occurs when distributed consensus protocols maintain multiple finality markers (e.g., finalized, safe, justified) but fail to validate ancestry relationships between them. The core issue is **incomplete invariant enforcement** where the protocol validates some but not all required ancestry constraints.
trigger_condition: Byzantine consensus client sends forkchoice updates with finality markers (safe, finalized) pointing to blocks on divergent forks, exploiting incomplete ancestry validation in the execution layer's forkchoice handler.
